mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear at the Verona Area High School with a full moon, and we are tracking an ISS pass tonight at 8:34 PM that will travel from over Cross Plains toward Oregon, reaching about halfway up the sky. Expect an overnight low of 49 degrees with no rain.

City officials have announced that a section of Hwy M near the future Aldi site will be closed from October 5 to October 7 for final asphalt and marking work, and please remember to always verify the authenticity of city emails as officials will never request payment via wire transfer.
We have a busy weekend ahead, starting with the Dane County Farmer's Market happening today, along with live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.

Regarding local public safety, officers handled a variety of calls recently, including an incident on September 10 where a burglary was reported in the 600 block of Hunters Cove Way involving a suspect who was apprehended after a gunshot was fired.
It is a great day to visit Culver's for their delicious flavor of the day, OREO REESE'S Cheesecake, and they are currently open until 10:30 PM.
